title: 第15章 疯魔的柳沐第16章 祸端起
lines: 九狱炎骨血脉竟然没有被封印！
贵宾席上数位家主霍然起身。
传说中焚天大帝的血脉竟然在这少年身上没有被彻底封印起来，
要知道九狱炎骨血脉若是一个不好就会在突破大境界之时引来九天雷罚，
到时候拥有九狱炎骨血脉之人所在之地方圆几百里都会瞬间被九天雷罚所击毁！
萧青山手中雷印发出嗡鸣，
似乎这雷印已经察觉到了林烬的九狱炎骨血脉的存在。
毒骨暴雨撞上炎骨屏障的瞬间，整个擂台被红黑交织的雾气笼罩。
柳沐突然发出凄厉尖啸，她精心炼制的本命血毒竟被炎骨生生炼化成精纯灵气！
更令她惊恐的是，那些本该受控的尸傀碎骨，此刻正不受控制地涌向林烬！
不！
怎么可能……将我的尸傀还给我！
柳沐发髻崩散，双目赤红如鬼。
她咬破十指在胸前画出诡异符咒，
观众席前排突然有七名柳家子弟抱头惨叫，精血化作流光没入擂台。
得到血祭加持的困阵骤然收缩，将方圆十丈化作血色领域。
林烬顿觉周身灵力凝滞，炎骨虚影竟被血色领域压制得明灭不定。
危急时刻，林烬爆喝一声：引星火入阵眼！
随后林烬福至心灵，突然撤去所有防御，
任由三根毒骨贯穿肩头，借势腾空跃至领域最高点。
他要自毁修为吗？
观战人群发出惊呼。
却见林烬染血的双手突然亮起星辰光点，
被血毒侵染的伤口迸发出璀璨金芒——正是淬体七重特有的！
蕴含星辰之力的骨髓与九狱炎骨产生共鸣，竟在血色领域顶部撕开裂缝！
北斗借势，九狱焚天！
林烬暴喝声震动全场。
七颗星辰虚影自裂缝坠落，与炎骨黑火融合成灭世火雨。
血色领域如遇骄阳的残雪般消融，柳沐精心布置的杀局竟成了反噬自身的熔炉！
柳沐绝望的嘶吼戛然而止。
当烟尘散尽，众人只见少女半跪在地，原本乌黑的长发竟变得雪白如霜。
她颤抖着举起右手，却发现方才画阵的指尖只剩下筋骨——
九狱炎火不仅破了血阵，更沿着因果线反噬施术者！
裁判长老正要宣布胜负，异变陡生！
“不，我不甘，我是不会输的！”
柳沐发出刺耳的尖叫声，随后，颈间突然浮现金色咒文，
破碎的青铜棺中飞出八道血光没入她体内。
content_en:
The Nine Hell Flame Bone bloodline has not been sealed!
Several family heads at the VIP table suddenly stood up.
The bloodline of the legendary Burning Emperor was not completely sealed in this young man.
You must know that if the Nine Hell Flame Bone Bloodline is bad, it will attract the Nine Heavens Thunder Punishment when it breaks through the great realm.
At that time, people with the Nine Hell Flame Bone bloodline will be instantly destroyed by the Nine Heavens Thunder Punishment within a radius of hundreds of miles!
The thunder seal in Xiao Qingshan's hand buzzed,
It seemed that the thunder seal had noticed the existence of Lin Jin's Nine Hell Flame Bone bloodline.
The moment the poisonous bone rainstorm hit the flame bone barrier, the entire arena was enveloped in red and black mist.
Liu Mu suddenly let out a shrill scream, and the blood poison she had carefully refined was actually refined into pure spiritual energy by the flaming bones!
What frightened her even more was that the corpses and bones that should have been controlled were now flowing towards Lin Jin uncontrollably!
No!
How is it possible... to return my corpse to me!
Liu Mu's bun fell apart and her eyes were as red as ghosts.
She bit her fingers and drew strange spells on her chest.
Suddenly, there were seven Liu family members in the front row of the audience, holding their heads and screaming, and their blood and essence turned into a stream of light and disappeared into the ring.
The trapped formation blessed by the blood sacrifice suddenly shrank, turning a ten-foot radius into a bloody field.
Lin Jin suddenly felt that his whole body's spiritual power was stagnant, and the phantom of the flame bone was suppressed by the bloody field, causing it to flicker.
At the critical moment, Lin Jin shouted loudly: draw the spark into the formation!
Then Lin Jin was so blessed that he suddenly removed all defenses.
Let the three poisonous bones pierce through your shoulders, and use the momentum to leap into the air to the highest point in the field.
Is he going to destroy his cultivation?
The spectators screamed.
But Lin Jin's blood-stained hands suddenly lit up with starlight spots,
The wounds infected by the blood poison burst out with bright golden light - unique to the seventh level of body tempering!
The bone marrow containing the power of the stars resonated with the Nine Hell Flame Bones, and actually tore a crack at the top of the bloody field!
Beidou takes advantage of the situation and burns the sky in nine hells!
Lin Jin's roar shook the entire audience.
The phantoms of seven stars fell from the cracks and merged with the flames, bones and black fire to form a rain of world-destroying fire.
The bloody realm melted like the remaining snow in the scorching sun, and Liu Mu's carefully arranged killing plan turned into a furnace that backfired on him!
No--!
Liu Mu's desperate roar stopped abruptly.
When the smoke and dust cleared, everyone saw the girl half-kneeling on the ground, and her long black hair turned as white as frost.
She raised her right hand tremblingly, only to find that only the muscles and bones were left on the fingertips where she had drawn the formation——
The flames of the Nine Hells not only broke the blood formation, but also backfired on the caster along the line of cause and effect!
The elder referee was about to announce the winner when something unexpected happened!
"No, I won't give in, I won't lose!"
Liu Mu let out a harsh scream, and then a golden spell suddenly appeared on his neck.
Eight rays of blood flew out of the broken bronze coffin and sank into her body.
